items.prompt: Why should a test avoid assuming a moved-from string is empty and every old view remains valid?
items.modelAnswer: The general source is valid but unspecified, and view validity is a separate owner/storage contract that can fail on move/mutation/destruction. Check destination values and safe source operations; discard or reacquire observers using verified live storage. Neither a successful run nor the word move proves observer lifetime.

criteria.text: Tests guaranteed behavior rather than incidental layout.
